light.text: Trend up, volatility normal, breadth broad.

tiles.name: Fear meter
tiles.about: Share of S&P 500 stocks whose TET mood is scared at the close.

tiles.name: Panic & Demand
tiles.about: Paul Desmond's panic (P) and demand (Q) scores for NYSE stocks: a 90% day is a panic or a demand day.

tiles.name: Put/Call
tiles.about: Put/call volume ratio of every option on Cboe (stocks, ETFs and indexes), and how high it ranks among past readings.

tiles.name: Washout & thrust
tiles.about: Whether the share of S&P 500 stocks above their 50-day average has washed out, and the Russell 2000 breadth thrust state.

extra.thrust_line: Arms when the line drops to the arm line.

tiles.name: Nasdaq new lows
tiles.about: Nasdaq-listed stocks closing at a 52-week low, as a count and as a share of the listings counted.

tiles.name: Trend breadth
tiles.about: Share of S&P 500 stocks that pass the TET trend check.

tiles.name: Buy the Dip Line
tiles.about: NYSE new highs vs new lows line: BUY or SELL, and how far the week's close is from a flip.

tiles.name: AI · semis breadth
tiles.about: Share of semiconductor stocks above their 50-day average, with the washout state of the AI, semis and high-beta groups.

tiles.name: Smart Money
tiles.about: Daily KDJ cross of the S&P 500 smart-money flow line, which adds up the index's moves after the open.

tiles.name: Dealer positioning
tiles.about: SPY against its gamma flip, from options open interest.

tiles.name: Cross-asset
tiles.about: Cross-asset regime from 0 to 100 across Nasdaq vs gold, Nasdaq vs commodities and the S&P 500 vs the dollar.

tiles.name: Inflation
tiles.about: Core CPI inflation over the past year, and whether the last three months ran faster or slower than that.

tiles.name: Bitcoin
tiles.about: Bitcoin's day change and how far it sits from its 200-week average.

tiles.name: Bubble check
tiles.about: Sornette LPPLS bubble check: how many of 13 fit windows flag a bubble in SPY, QQQ or SMH.

about.ranges: Each range is the session's close moved by the volatility expected over the next week or month. The inner band is set to hold 2 in 3 closes, the outer band 9 in 10.
about.tails: Bad day: at least one daily close-to-close loss of 2% or more in the next 5 sessions. Month dip: any close in the next 21 sessions 5% or more below the session's close. Normal is how often it happened since 2021 (or since 2013).
about.odds: How often the price was higher 5 and 21 sessions later: on all days since 2021 or 2013 (normally), and on days with today's risk light (days like today). n counts days; episodes counts separate runs of that light.

rules.buy: several bullish families agree (momentum, KDJ, options, trend, rotation) and none bearish; a family counts once
rules.watch: a washout setup with bullish families and nothing bearish, or bullish families with a bearish one
rules.avoid: bearish families agree and no bullish family
